prompt_diff_summary: Start from held challenger v4's system.md. Replace its insurance-any-reason clause with a literal cancel-eligibility block (insurance counts only for health or weather). Add: no mid-list transfer; basic economy can change cabin, passengers and bags but not flights; cabin price difference × passengers; read membership before counting bags; no invented workarounds after a denial; no tool-call JSON inside messages.
helper_diff_summary: Same as v4: extra_context re-appends the policy's own 'The current time is ...' line (only the docstring changed).
risks: 39 stays failed, because keeping 47 and 44 correct requires refusing an insured cancellation for a non-health, non-weather reason.

The basic-economy rule could make the agent offer cabin changes more readily. It only states what the policy's 'Change cabin' section allows, and it fixes the v4 regression on 22 (the agent wrongly said basic economy 'cannot be modified').
The no-workaround rule could suppress cancel-and-rebook in 23. It explicitly allows alternatives the user asks for, and in 23 the user proposes the split themselves.
The prompt is longer (about 11k chars), which could slow early turns. The new rules target known failures (6, 20, 22, 47 regressions in v4) and v4's other passing tasks keep their blocks.
